data.narrative:
Magdrive is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Mark Stokes and Thomas Clayson that has raised $22.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression analysis represents the only applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($22.5M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to Series A, this method implies a valuation of $56M. The peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Space & Aerospace universe (0 qualifying peers after filtering). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples is inapplicable because Magdrive's revenue is not disclosed, preventing application of the 23.9x sector median observed across public peers.

Given the single applicable method, the analysis supports a valuation range of $48M to $65M, centered on $56M. This range reflects uncertainty bands around the stage-progression estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of private peer benchmarking data at comparable stage and valuation tier, the lack of revenue visibility to anchor against public multiples, and limited ability to stress-test the 2.5x multiplier assumption against transaction history in this specific subsector. The analysis would benefit materially from revenue disclosure or access to pricing on recent seed-to-Series A transactions in space technology.
